blocks.prompt: 6 A sound has level \(L = 80\) dB and \(I_0 = 10^{-12}\ \text{W/m}^2\). Find the intensity \(I\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh Q5 ka ulta sawal hai: is dafa level diya hai aur intensity poochi hai.
Diya kya hai? \(L = 80\) dB aur \(I_0 = 10^{-12}\).
Find kya karna hai? Intensity \(I\), jo logarithm ke andar baithi hai.
Rule kaunsa? Log ke andar se cheez nikalni ho to exponential form mein badalte hain: \(\log x = y\) ka matlab \(x = 10^{y}\).
Plan: values rakhna, 10 se divide kar ke \(\log\) ko akela karna, exponential form likhna, aur \(10^{-12}\) se multiply kar ke \(I\) nikalna.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(L = 80\) dB, \(I_0 = 10^{-12}\ \text{W/m}^2\).
Maloom karna: intensity \(I\).
Tareeqa: formula \(L = 10\log\left(\frac{I}{I_0}\right)\) mein values rakhenge, \(\log\) ko akela karenge, aur exponential form se \(I\) bahar nikalenge.

Values rakhein
\[80 = 10\log\left(\dfrac{I}{10^{-12}}\right)\]
Kyun: decibel formula mein \(L = 80\) aur \(I_0 = 10^{-12}\) rakh diye.

Dono taraf 10 se divide karein
\[8 = \log\left(\dfrac{I}{10^{-12}}\right)\]
Kyun: form badalne se pehle \(\log\) ko akela karna zaroori hai, bilkul jaise exponential ko \(\ln\) se pehle akela karte hain.

Exponential form mein likhein
\[10^{8} = \dfrac{I}{10^{-12}}\]
Kyun: \(\log x = y\) ka matlab \(x = 10^{y}\); yahan \(x = \frac{I}{10^{-12}}\) aur \(y = 8\).
Dhyan dein: yahan \(e^{8}\) nahi likhna; decibel mein \(\log\) ka base 10 hai.

\(I\) nikaalein
\[I = 10^{8} \times 10^{-12}\]
\[= 10^{8-12} = 10^{-4}\ \text{W/m}^2\]
Kyun: dono taraf \(10^{-12}\) se multiply kiya. Same base ki powers multiply hon to exponents jama hote hain: \(8 + (-12) = -4\).

Tasdeeq
\[10\log\left(\dfrac{10^{-4}}{10^{-12}}\right) = 10\log(10^{8})\]
\[= 80\ \text{dB} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: jawab wapas rakhne se 80 dB mila, jo diya hua tha.
